messages.author: 3265c345842f7b01
messages.subject: ODE sample code
parts:
Hello,

I have just installed Stan for the first time. My interest is in implementing the data simulating script (p. 163) and parameter estimating script (p. 164) in the "stan-reference-2.5.0" manual for the oscillator example. I would like to run these scripts in R. Can somebody please provide the R code for i) calling the first one to simulate arbitrary data, and ii) calling the estimator code on that data to estimate the system parameters?

Thanks!

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ODE sample code
parts:
You’re in luck. I checked all that code in along
with the manual.

See the path:

src/docs/stan-reference/programs/ode/sho/

in the Stan release (not sure if it’s distributed
with RStan). You can see the code online at:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/tree/develop/src/docs/stan-reference/programs/ode/sho

- Bob
